purpose: development precision repair; original active and shadow artifacts remain unchanged
input_and_dt: finite binary32 values promoted exactly to binary64 before arithmetic; zero dt is a separate hold
state: persistent binary64, never replaced by a published binary32 output
initialization: copy preceding finite binary32 effective PID setpoint to binary64 unchanged if abs <= 2; otherwise reject entry
disarm_reset: set persistent state to exact binary64 zero; emit reset cause separately in wrapper
update: binary64 backward-Euler delta projected onto symmetric slew interval, then binary64 state cap
diagnostics: strict slew and cap comparisons on binary64 intermediates; diagnostic only; exact-intent flag identity not required
published_output: round capped binary64 state to nearest-even binary32; publication never feeds persistent state
arithmetic: binary64 nearest-even gradual underflow, no contraction, reassociation or fast math

acceptance.quantity: absolute propagated numerical next-state error against exact intent, plus separate published binary32 conversion

scope: development qualification; wrapper and target admission require separate evidence and scoped Claude AI technical review
